title: Household Chore Leaderboard
dataSources: Life score (`lifeos:score`), quests / tasks (`quest:task`), habit streaks (`streak:status`), life achievements (`achievement:life`), household leaderboard (`household:leaderboard`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The parody-the-enterprise meta layer — a Personal NOC (house-health wall), Personal SOC (entry / impossible-travel), Personal SRE (SLOs on your own habits), and a gamification layer (XP, achievements, streaks, household leaderboards) — all computed in Splunk over `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=household:leaderboard
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(points) as points by person _time
| stats sum(points) as total by person
| sort - total
description: Ranks household members by chore points earned, turning shared work into a friendly competition.
value: A leaderboard makes housework fairer and, for families, genuinely fun to keep on top of.
implementation: Ingest chore completions into `index=personal`; rank members by points.
visualization: Bar chart of household chore points by person.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks who has done the most chores, turning housework into a friendly family competition.
